subject: Security follow-up: pen-report timing, vuln SLAs, and questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@therahealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security follow-up: pen-report timing, vuln SLAs, and questionnaire kickoff

Hi Elena —

Great to meet the TheraHealth team on today's demo. Quick recap and action items from my side:

- Redwood summary: hosted API + optional dedicated/private deployments, emphasis on predictable latency and audit logging.
- Security asks you mentioned: SOC 2 status, vendor security questionnaire, and a previous penetration test report if available.

Can you confirm the following so we can qualify timelines on our side?
1) SOC 2 status (Type I/II / expected completion date)
2) Whether TheraHealth can share an internal pentest report or a summary of recent findings (redacted ok) and the preferred handback process
3) Any internal cadence or SLA expectations for vulnerability remediation we should be aware of (e.g., critical = 7/14 days, high = 30 days, etc.)

Next steps from Redwood: I attached our vendor security questionnaire (Redwood_PSQ_20270501.pdf) for your security team and a short pen-test access instructions doc we can provide to your testers if/when we coordinate a report handback. If you prefer, I can open a HubSpot record and next-step checklist (I included the link in metadata).

Proposed timeline: if SOC 2 details and pen-report availability are shared by EOD Thursday (2027-05-06), we can commit to a pen-report review and redaction checklist within 5 business days and schedule vuln-triage with your team the week after.

Thanks — attaching the PSQ and pen-test instructions for convenience.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PSQ_20270501.pdf, Redwood_Pentest_Instructions.docx
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@therahealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <pmo@therahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security follow-up: pen-report timing, vuln SLAs, and questionnaire kickoff

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the recap and the PSQ. Quick answers from our side:

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type I in March 2026 and are currently in the audit cycle for Type II; expected completion is mid-August 2027. We can provide the Type I report now and a SOC 2 roadmap.
- Pen-test report: We had an external pentest in November 2026. I need to confirm what we can share — I'll coordinate with our security lead (cc'd Rajiv). Redactions are fine; we typically provide an executive summary and a tester-signed attestation when asked by vendors.
- Vulnerability SLAs: Our standard supply-chain policy requests vendor triage windows of 14 days for critical, 30 days for high, and 90 days for medium/low, but we are open to negotiating depending on exposure and compensating controls.

I'll follow up with Rajiv on the pen-test attachment and whether we can surface the remediation timeline for specific findings. In the meantime, please send the vendor questionnaire link (we prefer a live Drive doc we can comment on).

—Elena
Elena Morales
Director, IT Risk & Compliance | TheraHealth
elena.morales@therahealth.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@therahealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security follow-up: pen-report timing, vuln SLAs, and questionnaire kickoff

Thanks Elena — really helpful. I've shared a live vendor security questionnaire link below for your team to edit/comment on: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-psq-thera.

Couple of clarifications from Redwood:
- Pen-test handback: our standard asks are an executive summary + file with test scope and findings (redacted PII), and we can sign an NDA amendment specific to the report.
- Remediation SLA proposal: we typically ask customers to commit to a triage acknowledgment within 72 hours and a remediation/mitigation plan within 7 business days for critical findings. We can accept your supply-chain preferred windows (14/30/90) as baseline for production pushes, but we recommend the 72-hour acknowledgment step to avoid drift.

Would you like Redwood to provide a short remediation playbook mapping common findings to our standard mitigations (we can attach a 2-page runbook)? If yes, I will loop Aditya (engineering) and Ben (security ops) to prepare that and to draft the pen-test access guide.

Proposed next meeting: 30 minutes with your security lead to confirm what can be shared from the Nov 2026 pentest, discussion on redaction, and agree SLA windows. I put a tentative slot for Thursday 2027-05-06 10:00 AM PT.

Best,
Mina

Date: 2027-05-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security follow-up: pen-report timing, vuln SLAs, and questionnaire kickoff

Looping in engineering and ops notes here.

Elena / Rajiv — thanks for the quick answers. A few operational points from Redwood engineering/security ops:

- Pen-test report request: we can accept an executive summary + redacted findings; if you can provide a tester attestation and scope doc that speeds internal verification.
- Access for re-tests: if TheraHealth prefers to have Redwood coordinate a scoped retest, we'll need the scope, IP allowlist, and a test window. We will provide a short PenTest_Instructions packet (attached in prior email) that covers throttling, endpoints, and contact points.
- SLA mapping: we are aligned with 72-hour acknowledgment + remediation plan within 7 business days for criticals in our public-facing customers; for production deployments we accept 14/30/90 as final delivery windows if compensating controls are already in place. For any disagreement on severity we propose a 48-hour joint triage call.

I'll prepare the short remediation playbook and a checklist for sharing the Nov 2026 pen-test. Mina, Ben and I will draft the playbook and the checklist and share by EOD Wednesday 2027-05-04.

-Aditya
Staff Software Engineer | Redwood Inference
